newsitem.title: USA: Amway Asia Pacific says Q3 sales $231 mln.
newsitem.headline: Amway Asia Pacific says Q3 sales $231 mln.

text.p: Amway Asia Pacific Ltd said Wednesday that its third quarter sales rose to $231 million versus $179 million in the prior year's third quarter.

For the nine months, ended May 31, net sales were $661 million, a 27.6 percent increase. Sales in China were $65 million for the third quarter of fiscal 1997 and $150 million for the nine month period, it said.
Full results are expected to be released Friday, July 11.

Amway Asia Pacific, which is based in Hong Kong, is the exclusive distribution vehicle for Amway Corp in Australia, Brunei, People's Republic of China, Hong Kong, Macau, Malaysia, New Zealand, Taiwan and Thailand.
